metadata.short_desc: Goes online on its own a few times a day, reads what it likes and thinks about it
metadata.desc: Lets your persona go online on its own a few times a day (Bilibili, tech news, forums...), pick what it likes, read it (web pages, Bilibili subtitles or frames) and think about it. Read-only, allow-listed; works with memory-core as long-term memory.
